description: Source code for handling SEAMA headers in MTD devices, including functions for fixing MD5 checksums and updating headers.

methods.name: seama_fix_md5
methods.description: Calculates and updates the MD5 checksum in a SEAMA header within a device image.

methods.name: mtd_fixseama
methods.description: Fixes the SEAMA header in an MTD device at a specified offset, updating the MD5 checksum and rewriting the block.
